title: 富国银行CEO：当前是银行业的好时光
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Well, talk about this transition then, because over the past few years, I mean, people will look at what you've done over the last few years and call that a turnaround story. Although, we should point out, Wells was in relatively good shape even when that asset cap was placed back in 2018.
segments.zh: 谈谈这个转型吧。过去几年，人们会把你做的事称为扭亏为盈的故事。但我们要指出，即便2018年资产上限被设定时，富国银行状况也相对良好。

segments.en: Was that a turnaround story, or was that just kind of regulatory rehab?
segments.zh: 那是扭亏为盈，还是只是监管修复？

segments.en: Well, I think I wouldn't call it, I think you're right, it's not a turnaround story. The company was always very strong, we always had a great franchise, but we had to fix things that needed to get fixed inside the company. But from our customer standpoint, we were serving them every day, we were making loans, we were taking deposits, we were constrained on growth, but we were there providing what we did day in and day out,
segments.zh: 我不会称之为扭亏为盈。公司一直很强，特许经营优秀，但内部有些问题需要修复。从客户角度看，我们每天都在服务，放贷、吸储，增长受限，但始终在提供日常服务。

segments.en: and financially, we were still doing okay. And when we looked at what we were able to deliver, we were not able to go our balance sheet, we've been focused a lot on efficiency inside the company,
segments.zh: 财务上我们表现尚可。由于无法扩张资产负债表，我们专注于内部效率提升。

segments.en: we've been focused a lot on growing our fees inside the business, so our corporate investment bank has grown very nicely, our credit card business and credit card spend is growing very, very nicely, focused on building treasury services,
segments.zh: 我们大力推动费用收入增长，企业投行业务增长良好，信用卡业务和消费增长非常强劲，同时着力建设财资服务。

segments.en: and now we can grow the balance sheet so we can more holistically serve customers. And that's what you see when you look at the results of this past quarter, with earnings per share of 25%, revenue growth, double digits, growth across every one of our businesses in terms of revenue,
segments.zh: 现在我们可以扩张资产负债表，更全面地服务客户。上季度业绩显示，每股收益增长25%，收入两位数增长，各业务线收入均实现增长。

segments.en: we're certainly in a different place, and our goal is to be viewed as the best financial service to provider in these businesses in the country.
segments.zh: 我们已处于不同阶段，目标是成为国内这些业务领域的最佳金融服务提供商。
